entry_points.text: Mmap rejects non-page-aligned offsets else delegates page-shifted; personality rejects 32-bit mode without 32-bit EL0 support else delegates; the unimplemented entry delegates to the generic handler.

Counter reads validate AMU then run locally or through a blocking cross-call, refusing remote targets without interrupts with a once-warning and permission error; fault helpers deliver protection-key and machine-check signals with address detail; bug addresses always validate; the vdso trampoline issues realtime signal return and stays byte-stable.

NMI availability follows the performance-unit interrupt mode; page clear and copy handle a full page through bulk, cache-zero or paired accesses; delays wait for counter advance using deadline, event or poll endings with the start sampled without preemption.

exports.text: SMP init records topology and NUMA, returns when max is zero, else prepares each possible peer through per-CPU ops and firmware presence. Stats print per-CPU per-kind counters with labels plus one error line.

Call on mask and single use the call kind; reschedule, timer broadcast and self IRQ-work use their kinds; KGDB fans to other online CPUs; backtrace tries SDEI NMI then generic fallback; panic self-stop is registerless NMI stop.

Suspend saves masks, pauses graph and idles, treats zero finisher as unsupported, and reserves per-MPIDR context at boot. Profiler skips lock addresses. Time sets clocks and broadcast, panics on zero rate and calibrates delay. Null static-call targets a zero stub with warn-once write. Error injection returns through the saved link.

CPC offers probe, single, paired and write for core and constant counters; paired rejects non-counters, absent hardware maps to no-device, and write is always unsupported, live when any present CPU has AMU. Watchdog period is threshold times max hertz else 5 GHz, and refresh skips zero max.
Native vdso forwards clock gettime, gettimeofday and clock getres; compat adds 64-bit clock and resolution variants plus gettimeofday.
IPv6 pseudo-header combines both addresses with length, protocol and partial sum, folding to 16 bits with endian-dependent protocol placement while addresses are read as wide halves.

hazards.text: Linking sets entry at the image address with the timer counter aliased, discards loader-only sections and aligns executable output; section order groups entry, read-only, hypervisor, trampoline, init, data and debug; the build fails when hypervisor, idmap, hibernate, trampoline, BSS, header, page-directory or kexec windows are violated.

invariants.text: Eight IPI kinds in fixed order: reschedule, call, stop, stop-NMI, timer, IRQ work, backtrace and KGDB, each with a trace label.
Spin-table boot stores the target logical id into pen-release with cache clean and event wake; the ops table named spin-table binds init, prepare and boot.

Consume callbacks vote whether to continue; plain entry forwards the program counter; reliable mode rejects register-derived exception boundaries and runs non-inline uninstrumented; BPF mode forwards counter with zero stack pointer and frame pointer on current.

Each backtrace address carries a source letter for frame, caller, task, register PC or unknown, plus flags for graph and kretprobe influence, parenthesized only when present; EFI info applies only to current inside EFI, and show-stack is barriered.

Joint sampling reads the constant counter before the core counter; extraction keeps the descriptor bit window shifted to zero base with address-selected counters; readers yield zero when AMU is missing, disabled or under erratum, treated as error.
A 16-entry table dispatches standard flag-derived condition predicates in architectural order, with the final two entries sharing always-true.

Cache maintenance rejects over-limit user addresses, runs inside a fault-trapped window, promotes clean to clean-invalidate, reports segmentation fault on failure and otherwise skips; trapped cache-type, counter, frequency, system-register and wait handlers return sanitized values or skip, signalling when the thread trap flag is set.

Compat serves frequency through one register and the 64-bit virtual counter split low and high across two registers, each table terminated and advancing four bytes; the exception-class table names every class with an unknown default.

The ABI table is fixed after init with native and compat slots; area moves update vdso and sigpage addresses; the vectors page is zeroed with tail helpers when enabled while sigpage is poison-filled then prefixed with sigreturn code; boot links descriptors before image init.

Vdso random uses the accelerated helper when SIMD is likely, else the system call, with a probe reporting unimplemented; crash metadata records address width, region bounds, offsets, T1 size, slide and authentication mask, zero without address authentication.

User copies return zero on success else the unwritten tail, reconciling faults with a single-byte retry; checksums fold with masked unaligned ends and odd-start swap, reading whole end words inside the checked extent; delays scale time intervals to loops then to cycles.

Branch and literal builders share a one-megabyte word-scaled reach with kind, width, condition and range checks, else a fault encoding; load-store builders map size and kind to base patterns with alignment and range enforcement, atomics limited to 32 and 64 bits with order bits, faulting on invalid input.

locks.text: Both installers take the target address-space write lock in killable mode, install native variable-plus-code or compat vectors-plus-vdso-plus-sigpage mappings, then unlock; interrupted acquisition installs nothing and failures clear the vdso pointer.

state_machines.text: NMI stop never returns: it masks asynchronous exceptions including pseudo-NMI, saves crash state when enabled with registers, marks the CPU offline, masks local SDEI, attempts the dying transition when crashing, then parks.

Dispatch validates the number for tracing, then routes the eight kinds to scheduler, call-function, NMI stop, broadcast receive, work, backtrace and debugger handlers, logging unknown numbers critically; the IRQ handler derives the index from hardware IRQ minus base modulo count.

Init checks ELF identity, derives page count and builds the frame list; setup reserves code plus data pages, installs the variable area then readable-executable code with branch protection, clearing the pointer on any failure; compat sequences vdso, sigpage and vectors then installs helpers, vdso and sigpage; vectors omit future write to stay shared while sigpage keeps it for breakpoints.

The stackless routine expands fixed constants with key and nonce into vector state, runs twenty add, xor and rotate rounds with lane shuffles per 64-byte block, adds back initial state until done, writes back the counter and clears sensitive vectors.

Validity needs an in-range present CPU with AMU and nonzero snapshots; max-ratio rejects zero inputs with once-warnings else stores scaled reference over maximum; ticks skip stalled counters, scale deltas and clamp. Enablement runs policy create, validate, allocate mask and register; hotplug joins or revokes while removal is ignored; queries enforce enablement, 20ms and housekeeping staleness with sibling search and distinct errors; idle refreshes expired CPUs; the frequency observer handles only policy creation and fans self-refresh to covered CPUs to avoid fallback-period races.

structs.text: One physical release address per possible CPU comes from device tree, erroring when missing or invalid; preparation requires nonzero, maps cached memory, writes the holding-pen address little-endian, cleans caches, wakes with an event and unmaps.

Unwind source enumerates unknown, frame, caller, task and register-PC origins; the flags union carries graph and kretprobe bits; state holds common state, task, graph index, source, flags and registers; frame tails pack pointer and link natively with an extra stack word for compat.

Call tables are register-context handler arrays sized by syscall count, prefilled with not-implemented from generated headers; the 64-bit table aliases personality natively while compat-aware selection picks compat handlers for the compat table.

Per-CPU maximum scale defaults to capacity squared alongside an enable mask and per-CPU counter samples with timestamps; firmware pairs core and constant 64-bit counters; trap hooks hold mask, value and handler; overflow stacks are aligned per-CPU word arrays.

Each ABI descriptor carries a name, image bounds, derived page count and mapping pointer; compat orders vectors, sigpage and vdso slots shown as [vectors], [sigpage] and [vdso] with move handlers; sigpage poison is 0xe7fddef1 little-endian; size flag sits at bit 31 with narrow and shift flags at 22; address immediates span 2MB with a 2-bit low field at 29 and high field at 5 plus masks.

Compat statfs rewrites size 88 to 84; 4K-offset mmap rejects page-excess low bits then shifts to pages; 64-bit arguments join the high half shifted by 32 plus the low half with endian-selected order; firmware counter ids are 0 for core and 1 for constant.
Thumb block state holds its low 2 bits at shift 25 and high 6 bits at shift 10, each with a matching width mask.
